Oral Assessment

Let learners answer spoken or typed questions in a guided sequence while AI adapts the dialogue and organizes evidence for a teacher, not as an autonomous examiner.

Supported scope
Transcript-first oral dialogue
Design focus
Human grading boundary
Built as a Moodle plugin first: permissions, native APIs and human review remain part of the workflow instead of being replaced by an external black box.
Practical results
Production-minded
✓
Adaptive follow-ups
Use objectives, criteria and conversation context to generate the next question when configured.
✓
Transcript survives failure
The learner response is stored before AI generation, so a provider failure does not lose the submitted evidence.
✓
Teacher-only grade
Only an authorized human reviewer can save a grade to the Moodle gradebook.
No direct audio provider
The module does not maintain a separate Whisper or external speech API integration.
Optional audio storage
Run transcript-only or store learner-recorded audio after explicit microphone permission.
No trait inference
AI instructions prohibit diagnoses or inferences about intelligence, personality, emotion, identity or medical traits.
What this plugin does

Oral Assessment creates a structured, auditable dialogue rather than a free-form chatbot. Teachers define objectives, criteria, round limits, duration and whether adaptive questioning is allowed.

AI may ask the next question, summarize transcript evidence and highlight points for review, but it never calculates or recommends the final grade. The final grade and feedback remain an explicit teacher action.

Features you get
Spoken or typed participation
Use browser-assisted speech recognition where available with typed fallback.
Configurable rounds
Control interaction count, duration and initial questions.
Evidence mapping
Organize transcript evidence against teacher-defined criteria or rubric guidance.
Attempt recovery
Resume in-progress attempts and keep already-submitted turns auditable.
Custom completion
Complete on submission, after teacher review or according to configured activity rules.
Privacy-aware deletion
Delete learner turns and audio while preserving another learner's attempt when a reviewer account is removed.

Also requires AI Bridge.
